packs.name: Cobblemon Legends: Ender
packs.author: JustJayden
packs.description: Cobblemon Legends - Ender Music Pack, including the best tracks from Pokémon's mainline and spin-off games. Whether you're in an Ominous Trial, sitting in Lake Verity from Legendary Monuments, or walking through a village in the rain, this pack has a track for everything! Now with bonus music from Synthetic Origins: Chrono Trigger and Eastward! (Relies on CobbleThemes or Bean'sBattleMusic for Overworld Battle Music)

packs.name: Skyrim OST

packs.name: YGGDRASIL
packs.author: Legroy
packs.description: Dark ambient music pack built with soundtracks from Skyrim's "Yggdrasil Music and SoundFX" mod as its core for a big modpack of ours. Aside from the main music blocks has separate music for jungle and desert/savannah biome types and structures, combat, underground, nether and end dimensions. Mods supported: The Hordes/The Lost City/Abandoned Structures/Yung's Better mods/Iron's Spells/Scorched Guns 2.

packs.name: Wuthering Waves OST
packs.description: Includes tracks from up to Version 3.1.

packs.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 OST
packs.description: Kingdom Come Deliverance 2's official ost into a minecraft soundtrack!! Feels medieval, really medieval. Battle themes, rains, villages, and more!

packs.name: Remember the Flowers OST
packs.author: Junebugspot
packs.description: Remember the Flowers has stuck with me since I've been playing through it. The soundtrack reminded me of the MC soundtrack constantly, I half expected for Sweden to start playing out of the blue. I've always wanted to make a music pack for TAM and the soundtrack of Remember the Flowers felt right alongside the Minecraft ambience by C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, Kumi Tanioka, Amos Roddy, and Fingerspit.(I may have missed some composers there but those were the ones that came to mind and I can find listed consistently). All credits go to the original composers of Remember The Flowers: Anthemics, Hyenablood, Cervines, and lastly Hop-Skip & The Chewtoys. As well as the rest of the team behind the visual novel of course. Music adapts to weather, and time of day(per biome) with some additional conditions such as health and bosses. 4-5 tracks per node, with minor overlap

packs.name: Sonic Unleashed Soundtrack
packs.author: Argentum722
packs.description: TAM Pack of music from Sonic Unleashed with a focus on the music alternating between Night and Day. 47 tracks total

packs.name: Spooky's Jump Scare Mansion (OST + sounds)
packs.author: ToboClic (Songs by Akuma Kira, Jarren Crist and Nolan Reese)
packs.description: A music pack inspired by “Spooky’s Jump Scare Mansion” (Akuma Kira). This pack includes musics for instant events, the title screen, boss fights, the Overworld, (with sub-rules for caves, the Warden and the Ancient City), the Nether, and the End.

packs.name: ImmersiveCraft - Every Journey Has a Soundtrack
packs.author: TOTOtheBOZO
packs.description: Adds more depth to the Minecraft Soundtrack. Featuring music for combat and boss battle scenarios, mob encounters, biomes, weather, time of day, and more, this music pack adapts to your gameplay without straying too far from the vanilla feel. Version 1.1.2 adds more songs, and a list of new songs for the end and nether dimensions.

packs.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 OST
packs.author: fiddledinks
packs.description: A Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 music overhaul. Includes 149 tracks with nodes matched to biomes, dimensions, bosses, combat, low-health, death, credits, and more! This is still a work in progress, so some nodes and biome placements may change over time. If you find any bugs, missing biomes, awkward track placements, or have suggestions for better song choices, please let me know!

packs.name: Soundtrack Reimagined [WIP]
packs.author: TheHairiestHippo
packs.description: A complete overhaul to minecraft music! Includes 80+ tracks, including Genshin Impact, Octopath Traveler, Marcus Warner's "Legendarium," among many others! I have lots more nodes and parameters to set, so this isn't the final project, but if you have any suggestions/bugs or missing parameters (mainly biomes) I would be happy to consider them!

packs.name: Undertale soundtrack (W.I.P)
packs.author: Chaotic person (Songs by Toby Fox and Laura Shigihara)
packs.description: A soundtrack composed of many Undertale and Deltarune songs set to play during certain situations, such as exploring your local village, or defeating the ender dragon.

packs.name: Project Zomboid OST
packs.author: Tiver
packs.description: 65 songs OST, with nodes for better experience!

packs.name: Hunter X Hunter OST
packs.author: Datura
packs.description: This is a music pack that uses music from the HxH soundtrack and is used for the majority of vanilla, It covers all dimensions and combat with some boss music, i intend to further expand the diversity but this soundtrack sounds good anytime.

packs.name: Mine Fables (Bug Fables OST)
packs.author: Pac246
packs.description: Bring music from the Bug Fables OST into Minecraft! Includes 30 songs from the game so far including music for The Overworld, Nether, End, 2 Battle themes, and 2 Boss themes.

packs.name: Pikmin: Adaptive
packs.author: CharaLK
packs.description: A Pikmin music pack with over 200 tracks, including songs from 7 installments of Pikmin! (Tracks from 1, 2, 3, 4, Hey!, Bloom, and Adventure are all included!) Every single biome and (important) structures have dedicated music that seamlessly fade in and out with variations of the *same* track for combat and (for most) underground and under water! With a config file over 2x larger than any other pack, this is (by that specific metric) the most adaptive pack yet! ---Please note that tracks may loop slightly suddenly in biomes, that's something I will fix in a future update!

packs.name: Mario Kart World - Free Roam
packs.author: Argentum722
packs.description: A music pack adding Free Roam tracks from Mario Kart World. Music will play based on gamemode, time of day, and (when in Survival Mode) current biome. Tracks that would play in VS Mode will play in Survival, while tracks that play in Free Roam play in Creative or Spectator. Features 95 tracks with more being added in future updates

packs.description: Bring the music from FF7 remake and rebirth into Minecraft, with battle themes!
